name: Carteret County, NC
findings: Carteret County has 214 nonprofit organizations. 89 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 75 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Carteret County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 economic development organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do economic development organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
